tests.title: Control-plane store bootstraps from system-info relays, waits for EOSE, then subscribes live
tests.description: Reuses the existing relay-bootstrap store test proving public discovery, EOSE-bounded catch-up, canonical author filtering, and live subscription startup for core read models.

tests.title: Public command helpers create services through signer-first request/result wiring
tests.description: Reuses the current helper-level unit test for kind `5964` plus correlated `7963` handling.

tests.title: Browser smoke journey uses signer-first public request kinds end to end
tests.description: Reuses the existing smoke journey that publishes public request kinds for service create, policy preview, deployment intent creation, and approval while excluding encrypted request kind `5980`.

tests.title: Successful service creation immediately renders the new service on `/services`
tests.description: Extend the current browser smoke test so it asserts the created service row appears on `/services` immediately after the successful signer-first create flow, without page reload or navigation away.
tests.failure_reason: Current active tests prove request publication and eventual relay-backed state only; they do not prove the HITL-required immediate list hydration.

tests.title: Public command helpers request deployment policy preview through kind `5989`
tests.description: Reuses the existing helper-level unit test for signer-first deployment policy preview request shaping and parsed result handling.

tests.title: Browser smoke journey publishes policy preview before deployment intent creation
tests.description: Reuses the current browser smoke test trace that includes kind `5989` in the deployment-modal path.

tests.title: Deployment intent creation stays blocked when policy preview fails
tests.description: New browser coverage should drive the service-detail deploy modal with a failing policy-preview result and prove that no `5961` deployment-intent publish occurs while the user sees blocking feedback.
tests.failure_reason: Current implementation and tests explicitly allow deployment intent creation when policy preview is unavailable.

tests.title: Deployment intent creation stays blocked when policy preview reports blockers
tests.description: New browser coverage should return a successful preview payload with blockers and prove the modal refuses to publish kind `5961` until the blocking condition is cleared.
tests.failure_reason: No active test proves blocker-driven gating, and current UI copy treats preview as advisory rather than authoritative gate behavior.

tests.title: Public command helpers create deployment intents with service/environment/artifact routing tags
tests.description: Reuses the current helper-level unit test for kind `5961` routing tags and correlated deployment-result handling.

tests.title: Public command helpers approve deployment intents through signer-first approval requests
tests.description: Reuses the current helper-level unit test for kind `5966` request shaping and correlated approval-result handling.

tests.title: Deployment history and pending approvals remain reactive to relay-backed state
tests.description: Reuses the current browser smoke test that proves `/deployments` and `/deployments/pending` update from relay-backed state after approval.

tests.title: Browser E2E proves the approved end-to-end core public flow
tests.description: Upgrade the existing smoke journey so one browser test proves the full approved contract: immediate service visibility after create, successful policy preview as a gate, deployment intent creation, approval, relay-backed history/detail rendering, and continued exclusion of encrypted request kind `5980`.
tests.failure_reason: The current smoke test proves the older advisory/eventual contract, not the newly approved immediate-hydration and policy-gating journey.

known_gaps: Immediate `/services` list hydration after successful signer-first create is approved intent but not yet proven by active tests.
Policy preview gating on `/services/[id]` is approved intent but active behavior and tests still allow deployment intent creation when preview fails or is only advisory.
No single browser E2E currently proves the full approved core public journey after the 2026-05-05 HITL decisions.

implementation_notes: This matrix now tracks the approved intent recorded in HITL-CORE_SERVICE_TO_DEPLOYMENT-001 and -002 rather than the previously verified eventual/advisory behavior.
Existing passing evidence for relay bootstrap, signer-first public request shaping, approval flow, and relay-backed history reactivity remains valid and is preserved.
The slice should not be treated as fully verified again until the immediate-hydration and policy-gating gaps are implemented and covered.
